title: Split mixed boundary responsibilities
why: One function coordinates several unrelated external boundaries, increasing coupling and change surface.
suggestion: Keep orchestration explicit, or move independently changing boundary work behind focused operations.
limitations: Control-flow blocks are not treated as functions. Comments and supported string literals are masked before brace-delimited function extraction.

Persistence requires a database/repository receiver, a connection/transaction operation, or an explicit SQL API. Generic collection insertion, UI/entity update calls, lowercase file accessors, and thread spawning are not evidence of persistence, filesystem construction, or process execution. Process evidence requires a recognizable process API; aliased or user-defined wrappers are not resolved.
